name: Hollis Wick
life: “I still remember the stairs where my mother first asked for my arm.” People around the corner outside Coastal Barber know Hollis by a small Thursday habit. Hollis usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I want to swap homes with the upstairs family because my mother can't climb my stairs anymore.
appearance: Out of work clothes, look for a moss-green cardigan and a stitched row of blue crosses along an old repair. Hollis has an aquiline nose and a square chin, with a soft fringe that falls across one eyebrow. Hollis folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing during a conversation.
personality: Hollis can be lavish with time and quite careful with cash. A free afternoon is sometimes the biggest gift Hollis can afford to give, and family knows to take it seriously.
agenda: To test a home swap before either tenant gives notice.
family: Alma Pike is Hollis’s half-sibling. Hollis is allowed to ask about the bad news afterward. Alma calls about good news first. Neither wants every family conversation to begin with a bill, a diagnosis or an apology. Asked about *Overdue by a lifetime*, Alma says, “The head said I wasn't ready for this book.”
connections: Franklin Pike. A housing swap takes somebody willing to carry furniture and witness the paperwork.

reactions.situation: The household must choose between paying a deposit and renewing
reactions.response: Hollis lays out the two household costs and asks which deadline comes first.
